oneLine: Roney Lima do Nascimento is the author of Generative AI for Teachers, a mathematician and PhD candidate at the University of São Paulo, and an independent AI solutions developer and consultant working on artificial intelligence in education and in companies.
fiftyWords: Roney Lima do Nascimento is the author of Generative AI for Teachers (Amazon, 2025) and Inteligência Artificial Generativa para Professores (Editora Dialética, 2026). A PhD candidate in Pure Mathematics at the University of São Paulo, he builds AI systems for companies and schools and trains teachers to use them. He delivered his ICAILY 2026 keynote online.
longFirst: Roney Lima do Nascimento is an author, mathematician, AI solutions developer and applied AI researcher. He wrote Generative AI for Teachers (Amazon, 2025) and Inteligência Artificial Generativa para Professores (Editora Dialética, 2026), whose launch at Livraria da Vila took place on 9 October 2026. By 14 October, he had published 18 original articles on education, AI and responsibility, including work for ISTE+ASCD, HEPI, Folha de S.Paulo and The Fulcrum.
longSecond: He is a PhD candidate in Pure Mathematics at the Institute of Mathematics and Statistics of the University of São Paulo, supervised by Prof. Raul Antonio Ferraz and funded by CAPES, with research on flat ternary cyclotomic polynomials. He works as an independent AI solutions developer and consultant, building AI agents for companies and running AI training for schools and organisations, and teaches IB Diploma Programme Mathematics and an applied generative AI elective at Colégio São Luís in São Paulo. His AI platforms for education reach more than 15,000 educators every month. He delivered his ICAILY 2026 keynote online, and a peer reviewer for Education and Information Technologies (Springer). He also presented at DataMinitech. During September and October, he led four AI training sessions at Colégio São Luís with teachers from early years, primary and secondary education. Teacher development is his priority: checking AI answers, judging their value for a lesson, and giving teachers time, support, professional autonomy and a voice in school decisions about AI.
ledeEn: Roney Lima do Nascimento is the author of Generative AI for Teachers and Inteligência Artificial Generativa para Professores; a mathematician and PhD candidate in Pure Mathematics at the University of São Paulo (IME-USP); an independent AI solutions developer and consultant, building AI agents for companies and running AI training for schools and organisations; an IB Diploma Programme Mathematics teacher at Colégio São Luís, São Paulo; and an applied AI researcher whose platforms for education reach more than 15,000 educators every month. He delivered his ICAILY 2026 keynote online. In 2026, he published 18 original press articles and led four AI training sessions at Colégio São Luís during September and October. He also presented at DataMinitech.
ledePt: Roney Lima do Nascimento é autor de Inteligência Artificial Generativa para Professores (Editora Dialética, 2026) e Generative AI for Teachers (Amazon, 2025); matemático e doutorando em Matemática Pura no Instituto de Matemática e Estatística da Universidade de São Paulo (IME-USP); Desenvolvedor de Soluções de IA e professor de Matemática do IB Diploma Programme no Colégio São Luís, em São Paulo; e pesquisador em IA aplicada, com plataformas educacionais que alcançam mais de quinze mil educadores por mês. Participou online como palestrante principal do ICAILY 2026. Até 14 de outubro de 2026, publicou 18 artigos originais na imprensa. Em setembro e outubro, conduziu quatro formações em IA no Colégio São Luís, com docentes da Educação Infantil, do Ensino Fundamental e do Ensino Médio. Também realizou uma apresentação no DataMinitech.
